title: HAPTIC Traffic
description: Incident-first HAPTIC dataplane traffic, route, backend-target, HAProxy capacity and failure diagnostics.

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Traffic volume across the application-route filters above. This is context, not a health signal.

panels.title: Route and HTTP status producing most 5xx

defaults.noValue: No 5xx responses in the selected time range

panels.description: Application route and HTTP status with the largest current 5xx rate. The value measures affected requests; the name distinguishes failures such as 503 and 504.

panels.title: Application routes producing 5xx
panels.description: Number of distinct application routes currently producing 5xx responses. The adjacent card names the route with the greatest affected-request rate.

panels.title: Unavailable backend target pods
panels.description: Number of configured backend target pods that at least one HAPTIC replica currently sees as unavailable; the target-pod row names them.

panels.title: Fleet denied request rate
panels.description: HAProxy frontend denials do not carry route labels. This fleet-level signal cannot attribute a denial to an Ingress.

panels.title: Backend target pods with queued requests
panels.description: Number of populated backend target pods currently queueing requests.

panels.title: Traffic by HTTP status
panels.description: Request rate split by the HTTP status emitted by Vector. Broad classes hide materially different failures such as 401, 404, 503 and 504.

panels.title: 4xx ratio by route and termination state

targets.expr: clamp_max((topk(15, sum by (exported_namespace,ingress,service,host,path,term,status) (rate(haptic_ingress_controller_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace",controller_pod=~"$haptic_pod",exported_namespace=~"$workload_namespace",ingress=~"$ingress",service=~"$service",host=~"$host",path=~"$path",method=~"$method",server=~"$backend_target",status=~"4..",term=~"$termination"}[$__rate_interval])) / ignoring(term,status) group_left clamp_min(sum by (exported_namespace,ingress,service,host,path) (rate(haptic_ingress_controller_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace",controller_pod=~"$haptic_pod",exported_namespace=~"$workload_namespace",ingress=~"$ingress",service=~"$service",host=~"$host",path=~"$path",method=~"$method",server=~"$backend_target",term=~"$termination"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9))), 1)

panels.description: Contribution of each HTTP 4xx status and HAProxy termination state to all requests for the application route. Stacked components sum to the route 4xx ratio. Aggregated across the selected HAPTIC pods.

panels.title: 5xx ratio by route and termination state

targets.expr: clamp_max((topk(15, sum by (exported_namespace,ingress,service,host,path,term,status) (rate(haptic_ingress_controller_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace",controller_pod=~"$haptic_pod",exported_namespace=~"$workload_namespace",ingress=~"$ingress",service=~"$service",host=~"$host",path=~"$path",method=~"$method",server=~"$backend_target",status=~"5..",term=~"$termination"}[$__rate_interval])) / ignoring(term,status) group_left clamp_min(sum by (exported_namespace,ingress,service,host,path) (rate(haptic_ingress_controller_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace",controller_pod=~"$haptic_pod",exported_namespace=~"$workload_namespace",ingress=~"$ingress",service=~"$service",host=~"$host",path=~"$path",method=~"$method",server=~"$backend_target",term=~"$termination"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9))), 1)

panels.description: Contribution of each HTTP 5xx status and HAProxy termination state to all requests for the application route. Stacked components sum to the route 5xx ratio. Aggregated across the selected HAPTIC pods.

panels.title: Request rate by route
panels.description: Request rate per application route, aggregated across the selected HAPTIC pods.

panels.title: Find the affected application or route
Abnormal HAProxy termination states by route
panels.description: Non-normal HAProxy termination states split by route. `----` is normal; examples include SC (server connection failed), cD (client timeout while sending data), and PC (proxy connection/socket limit). Look up every code in the [HAProxy 3.4 termination-state reference](https://docs.haproxy.org/3.4/configuration.html#8.5).

panels.title: Find the broken backend target pod
Request rate by backend target pod
panels.description: Exact request rate sent to each selected backend target pod, retaining its application route. This exposes uneven load and a single silent replica.

panels.title: 5xx ratio by backend target pod and HTTP status

targets.expr: clamp_max((topk(20, sum by (exported_namespace,ingress,service,host,path,server,status,term) (rate(haptic_ingress_controller_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace",controller_pod=~"$haptic_pod",exported_namespace=~"$workload_namespace",ingress=~"$ingress",service=~"$service",host=~"$host",path=~"$path",method=~"$method",server=~"$backend_target",status=~"5..",term=~"$termination"}[$__rate_interval])) / ignoring(status,term) group_left clamp_min(sum by (exported_namespace,ingress,service,host,path,server) (rate(haptic_ingress_controller_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace",controller_pod=~"$haptic_pod",exported_namespace=~"$workload_namespace",ingress=~"$ingress",service=~"$service",host=~"$host",path=~"$path",method=~"$method",server=~"$backend_target",term=~"$termination"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9))), 1)

panels.description: Exact 5xx contribution per backend target, HTTP status and termination state. A single broken replica is visible even when healthy siblings dilute the route-wide ratio.

panels.title: Unavailable targets by HAPTIC pod (empty is healthy)
panels.description: Exception-only timeline: it creates a row only while a concrete backend target is unavailable from a concrete HAPTIC pod. No rows means every selected target is available. Use the HAPTIC pod and backend target pod filters to narrow a failure.

panels.title: Target connection errors
panels.description: Failed connections attributed to the concrete backend pod.

panels.title: Target response errors
panels.description: Invalid or failed responses attributed to the concrete backend pod.

panels.title: Target health-check failures
panels.description: Active health-check failures attributed to the concrete backend pod.

panels.title: Requests by method
panels.description: HTTP method distribution inside the selected application-route scope.

panels.title: Requests by domain
panels.description: Traffic grouped by configured domain.

panels.title: Requests by application
panels.description: Traffic grouped by Kubernetes namespace, Service and Ingress.

panels.title: Locate latency in the request path
Request p95 by application route
panels.description: Raw latency remains separated by route. Compare a route with its own history or expectation, never with an unrelated endpoint.

panels.title: Upstream phase p95 by application route
panels.description: Route-preserving phase split. Filter to an affected route before using it to localize delay to connect, first byte, or response transfer.

panels.title: Request rate vs weekly seasonal prediction by route

targets.expr: topk(15, quantile without (week) (0.5, label_replace(sum by (exported_namespace,ingress,service,host,path) (rate(haptic_ingress_controller_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace",controller_pod=~"$haptic_pod",exported_namespace=~"$workload_namespace",ingress=~"$ingress",service=~"$service",host=~"$host",path=~"$path",method=~"$method",server=~"$backend_target",status=~"$status",term=~"$termination"}[4h] offset 166h)), "week", "1w", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (exported_namespace,ingress,service,host,path) (rate(haptic_ingress_controller_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace",controller_pod=~"$haptic_pod",exported_namespace=~"$workload_namespace",ingress=~"$ingress",service=~"$service",host=~"$host",path=~"$path",method=~"$method",server=~"$backend_target",status=~"$status",term=~"$termination"}[4h] offset 334h)), "week", "2w", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (exported_namespace,ingress,service,host,path) (rate(haptic_ingress_controller_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace",controller_pod=~"$haptic_pod",exported_namespace=~"$workload_namespace",ingress=~"$ingress",service=~"$service",host=~"$host",path=~"$path",method=~"$method",server=~"$backend_target",status=~"$status",term=~"$termination"}[4h] offset 502h)), "week", "3w", "", "") or label_replace(sum by (exported_namespace,ingress,service,host,path) (rate(haptic_ingress_controller_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace",controller_pod=~"$haptic_pod",exported_namespace=~"$workload_namespace",ingress=~"$ingress",service=~"$service",host=~"$host",path=~"$path",method=~"$method",server=~"$backend_target",status=~"$status",term=~"$termination"}[4h] offset 670h)), "week", "4w", "", "")))

panels.description: Actual route RPS against a robust weekly seasonal prediction: the median of four-hour windows centred on the same time of day 1, 2, 3 and 4 weeks ago. Missing weeks are ignored, so confidence grows as history accumulates. This follows the GitLab Prometheus seasonal-baseline pattern and compares every route only with itself.

panels.title: Upstream response p95 vs weekly seasonal prediction by route

targets.expr: topk(15, quantile without (week) (0.5, label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (exported_namespace,ingress,service,host,path,le) (rate(haptic_ingress_controller_response_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace",controller_pod=~"$haptic_pod",exported_namespace=~"$workload_namespace",ingress=~"$ingress",service=~"$service",host=~"$host",path=~"$path",method=~"$method",server=~"$backend_target",status=~"$status",term=~"$termination"}[4h] offset 166h))), "week", "1w", "", "") or label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (exported_namespace,ingress,service,host,path,le) (rate(haptic_ingress_controller_response_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace",controller_pod=~"$haptic_pod",exported_namespace=~"$workload_namespace",ingress=~"$ingress",service=~"$service",host=~"$host",path=~"$path",method=~"$method",server=~"$backend_target",status=~"$status",term=~"$termination"}[4h] offset 334h))), "week", "2w", "", "") or label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (exported_namespace,ingress,service,host,path,le) (rate(haptic_ingress_controller_response_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace",controller_pod=~"$haptic_pod",exported_namespace=~"$workload_namespace",ingress=~"$ingress",service=~"$service",host=~"$host",path=~"$path",method=~"$method",server=~"$backend_target",status=~"$status",term=~"$termination"}[4h] offset 502h))), "week", "3w", "", "") or label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (exported_namespace,ingress,service,host,path,le) (rate(haptic_ingress_controller_response_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace",controller_pod=~"$haptic_pod",exported_namespace=~"$workload_namespace",ingress=~"$ingress",service=~"$service",host=~"$host",path=~"$path",method=~"$method",server=~"$backend_target",status=~"$status",term=~"$termination"}[4h] offset 670h))), "week", "4w", "", "")))

panels.description: Actual upstream-response p95 against the median p95 of four-hour windows centred on the same time of day 1, 2, 3 and 4 weeks ago. Each route is compared only with its own seasonal history; missing weeks are ignored.

panels.title: Connection capacity by pod
panels.description: Current connections divided by the HAProxy process hard maximum, separately for every ingress pod.

panels.title: Idle time by pod
panels.description: HAProxy scheduler idle percentage per ingress pod; sustained low values indicate CPU saturation.

panels.title: Run queue by pod
panels.description: Runnable HAProxy tasks waiting for CPU, separately per ingress pod.

panels.title: Frontend network throughput
panels.description: Total frontend throughput per ingress pod, summed across its frontends. Inbound is positive above zero; outbound is mirrored below zero so direction and imbalance are visible at a glance.
